name: Morning list
description: A list of what is open for you, every weekday morning. One agent terminal, one element that gathers the list, and a schedule that runs it at 08:30. The agent on that terminal needs whatever connections the list is to be gathered from (a chat, a calendar, mail): the template brings none.

terminal.name: helper
terminal.note: Start an agent here that has the connections your list comes from. The schedule “My morning list” runs on this terminal.

element.name: Morning list
element.instructions:
Gather what is open for your owner today: {{task}}
Look where you have a connection: messages that ask them for something, meetings today, things they said they would do. Leave out what is only for information.
element.doneWhen: A list is handed in: one line for each thing, with who asked and by when if that is known. An empty list if there is nothing.

needs.name: connections to where your day is
needs.note: A chat, a calendar or mail that the agent on this terminal can read.
